name: claude-md-packs
description: The claude-md configuration as plugins: install the base engineering team, then add the marketing and council packs per project as needed; add ecc only in projects that need it (it costs about 15k always-on tokens). The security baseline (settings.json) is a separate classic install — see setup.md.

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Core engineering team — 24 least-privilege, zero-network agents (planning, review, implementation, debugging, testing, devops, ops triage, docs, curated stack experts) plus 5 skills — regression-guard (fix-once: REGRESSIONS.md ledger + guard run before done), /caveman (terse output), secure-code-reviewer (OWASP audit), work-quality-checker (pre-send executive QA), setup-advisor (recommends trusted, additive installs with evidence and token cost; installs only on approval) — and the /implement-plan command (execute a plan file end-to-end via pack subagents, ledger-aware). The main install; pair it with the settings.json security baseline (see setup.md). Ships one static, no-network SessionStart hook (a working-agreement reminder at startup, /clear and compaction).

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: 7 marketing & content agents — conversion-copywriter, content-writer, content-editor, email-campaign-writer, growth-strategist, and the config's only two network-enabled agents: content-researcher (Tavily search) and seo-rank-monitor (DataForSEO), both read-only on files — plus 2 skills: ai-writing-tells (the single banned-patterns list the writers cite) and brand-voice (applies brand/voice.md), and the /marketing:draft and /marketing:review commands. Ledger-aware: work is checked against brand/banned-phrases.txt and matching REGRESSIONS.md rows. Network only on the two read-only researchers.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: The 6-seat decision council (optimist, pessimist, out-of-the-box, skeptic, pragmatist, chair) plus the /council skill that fans a question to the seats and synthesizes a verdict; each seat gets the question, the minimum project context and matching REGRESSIONS.md rows. Chat fallback: where sub-agents aren't available (Claude chat, the Desktop Chat tab), the skill runs the five seats sequentially and blind, then the chair synthesis. Pure reasoners — no network, no file writes.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: A curated, security-audited subset of ECC (affaan-m/ECC, MIT): 41 agents (per-language reviewers and build-error resolvers for Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C#, C++, Dart/Flutter, Python, TypeScript, React, Vue, Django, FastAPI, PHP, plus TDD, refactor, accessibility, and open-source release agents), 116 engineering skills, and 34 slash-commands — an engineering core plus 10 ECC agent-engineering knowledge skills (the broader ECC harness/command machinery was trimmed for token economy). Namespaced separately from base so nothing collides; pure markdown — no scripts, hooks, or installers. Network stays governed by the settings.json baseline. See plugins/ecc/ATTRIBUTION.md.
